policy.advertised_operations: for every offered tool whose capability is not available:false, in tools_available order: ffprobe, epub_inspect, audiobook_inspect, arr_lookup {}; decode_sample {"at": o} for every advertised offset, then {"full": true} when the full decode is advertised as recorded, on request or a bounded run; audio_sample {"at": o, "stream": 0} for every advertised offset; frame_sample and ocr {"at": o} for every advertised offset, or, when the offsets are "any", the start of every recorded reading range and 0; a tool with no advertisement {} (windowed tools {"at": 0})
policy.revealed_candidates: every `available` link of the v3 open list over the case evidence plus all results served so far, and over the case evidence plus each single served result; ocr {"frame": name} for every frame a served frame_sample returned; up to 3 rounds
policy.excluded: a candidate equivalent to case evidence (it is already shown); candidates whose served result is unavailable
policy.witness: iterative deepening over sets of distinct served candidates, smallest first, in pool order; cost = calls + every extra page of the first message and of each witness result (pages counted by the real v3 session); a witness costs at most 6; at most 5000 checker evaluations per row
policy.satisfied: every diagnosis prerequisite of an accepted class and every action prerequisite of a supported action that class can take is met (insufficient_evidence: no other class and not healthy established); reference roles depend on the decision written and are assessed for written decisions only
policy.limits: replay only (no live collector); offsets outside the advertisement and frames other than those returned are not explored; stream arguments other than 0 are not explored; sets larger than six calls are not searched; free-text identity and M9 stay `unknown` to the checker; explicit EPUB excerpts are not explored (the v3.1 checker reads no excerpt, C32-4); body and excerpt identity is judged by hand, never computed
policy.changes: passability-1 applied to format v3.1-format: (1) the case evidence resolved as the v3.1 run resolved it; (2) the checker reads the observations typed as the v3.1 audit types them (an explicit excerpt is a reading; the legacy spine heads are withheld); (3) candidates served by tools behaviour v3; an epub_inspect candidate is already shown only when a case-evidence result of the same call carries the same body view; links over the v3.1 analysis; page cost by the v3.1-format session at the run's wire budget; (4) fidelity reads the v3.1-format source rendering with the same parser as the delivered transcript and also requires every deciding observation's statement kinds, provenance and report metadata to arrive as the source states them (missing or changed: presentation problem; on an unfetched page: not obtained); (5) once body evidence (delivered nonempty text or positively evidenced excerpt availability) is among the observations, an identity_disagreement row the checker reports unmet is reported unknown; (6) a row of an identity-sensitive label whose case shows or serves body evidence, computed as model error, not obtained, presentation problem, obtainable not obtained or evidence gap, is undetermined (hand judgement), the computed category kept beside it
policy.body_evidence: text: nonempty delivered excerpt or heading text; available: an indexed non-navigation spine item with characters > 0; none: absent, null, empty or zero; key presence alone is never body evidence
